product.name: TravelPerk Business Travel Platform
product.description: An all-in-one platform for booking, managing, and controlling corporate travel including flights, hotels, trains, and car rentals.

product.name: Policies and Approvals Management
product.description: A system to automate travel policy enforcement and approval workflows to control budgets and ensure compliance.

product.name: FlexiPerk Flexible Travel
product.description: A flexible travel service allowing easy trip cancellations with guaranteed refunds of at least 80%.

product.name: 24/7 Customer Support
product.description: Around-the-clock customer service staffed by real people to assist travelers and travel managers globally.

product.name: Expense Management and Integrations
product.description: Tools to export travel spend data to finance systems, automate expense reporting, and centralize invoicing.

product.name: Travel Analytics and Reporting
product.description: A dashboard offering real-time insights and detailed reports on corporate travel spending and policy compliance.
